name: The World, 1 January 1876
description: The world from 84°N to 58°S on an upright Web Mercator map of 175,104 tiles (about 78 km per tile at the equator, Antarctica left off), with its real climates, mountains, forests, and rivers, as it stood on Saturday 1 January 1876. Empires, kingdoms, republics, vassals, protectorates, and the independent and unrecognised peoples that still held land: 119 polities in all. Turns are days. Borders are approximate to a tile; colonial claims show who held the coast and the river routes, not paper claims. Several wars are already under way: the Third Carlist War and the Ten Years' War against Spain, the Aceh War, the Egyptian-Ethiopian War, the Russian suppression of Kokand, the Qing campaign against Kashgaria, Chile's pacification of Araucania, and the Caste War of Yucatan.
intro: 1 January 1876. Steam, the telegraph, and rifled guns are reshaping the world, and the great powers are carving up what is left of it. Queen Victoria's empire spans the globe, the Qing court faces rebellion and encroachment, and Meiji Japan has just abolished its domains and is about to press a treaty on Korea. Japan is the default command; any nation can be played with --nation.

nations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
nations.leader: Queen Victoria; Prime Minister Benjamin Disraeli
nations.notes: Workshop of the world and mistress of the seas. Colonies and the Indian Empire are held as part of the realm.

nations.name: German Empire
nations.leader: Emperor Wilhelm I; Chancellor Otto von Bismarck

nations.name: Khedivate of Egypt
nations.notes: Holds the Nile to the Great Lakes, the Red Sea coast, Harar and the Somali coast, and is at war with Ethiopia.

nations.name: Kingdom of Spain
nations.leader: King Alfonso XII; Prime Minister Antonio Canovas del Castillo

nations.name: Carlist Kingdom
nations.notes: Holds the interior of Navarre and the Basque provinces. Historically the Carlist cause collapsed within two months.

nations.name: Grand Duchy of Luxembourg
nations.government: Grand duchy in personal union with the Netherlands

nations.name: Kingdom of Denmark
nations.notes: Also holds Iceland, the Faroes, Greenland, and the Danish West Indies.

nations.name: Kingdom of Norway
nations.government: Constitutional monarchy in union with Sweden

nations.name: Principality of Montenegro
nations.notes: Nominally Ottoman but independent in fact; its independence was recognised in 1878.

nations.name: Principality of Andorra
nations.leader: Co-princes: the Bishop of Urgell and the President of France

nations.name: Maya Cruzob of Chan Santa Cruz
nations.government: Military and religious state of the Speaking Cross
nations.notes: The independent Maya state of the Caste War of Yucatan, which lasted until 1901.

nations.name: Republic of Cuba in Arms
nations.notes: The insurgent government of the Ten Years' War (1868-1878), holding the countryside of Camaguey and Oriente.

nations.name: Republic of Bolivia
nations.notes: Still holds the Pacific coast of the Atacama.

nations.name: Mapuche Confederation
nations.notes: Independent Araucania, under pressure from Chile.

nations.name: Lakota Nation
nations.leader: Chiefs Sitting Bull and Crazy Horse
nations.notes: The Great Sioux Reservation and the unceded Powder River country.

nations.name: Qing Empire
nations.leader: Guangxu Emperor, with the Empresses Dowager Ci'an and Cixi

nations.name: Empire of Japan
nations.government: Imperial monarchy under the Meiji oligarchy

nations.name: Outer Mongolia
nations.government: Banner princes under the Jebtsundamba Khutuktu

nations.name: Emirate of Kashgaria
nations.notes: Carved out of Qing Xinjiang in the 1860s and recognised by Britain, Russia, and the Ottomans.

nations.name: Kingdom of Nepal
nations.leader: King Surendra; Prime Minister Jung Bahadur Rana

nations.name: Dai Nam (Vietnam)
nations.notes: Cochinchina has already been ceded to France.

nations.name: Emirate of Jabal Shammar
nations.leader: Emir Muhammad bin Abdullah Al Rashid

nations.name: Sheikhdom of Bahrain
nations.leader: Sheikh Isa bin Ali Al Khalifa

nations.name: Hyderabad State
nations.leader: Nizam Mahbub Ali Khan, under the regent Salar Jung

nations.name: Kingdom of Madagascar
nations.leader: Queen Ranavalona II; Prime Minister Rainilaiarivony

nations.name: Maori King Movement
nations.notes: The King Country, closed to European settlers.
